shorts.title: A Leopard Seal Moved Into Auckland and Wrecked Dinghies
shorts.outro: Owha only wrecked dinghies. Down in Antarctica, Doug leaned out of a boat for a selfie with that famous smile. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DOES THAT SMILE REALLY MEAN?
shorts.description: Owha, a 300-kilogram leopard seal, punctured and capsized dinghies in an Auckland marina, and researchers found she was one of 216 regular visitors to New Zealand, and the full episode reveals what that famous smile really means when Doug leans out of a boat in Antarctica.

shorts.title: A Leopard Seal Spent Four Days Trying to Feed a Photographer
shorts.outro: Then Doug went down to see if she would feed someone even less capable. She tried. What Doug did next is in the full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID SHE TRY TO FEED DOUG?
shorts.description: A leopard seal took Paul Nicklen's head in her mouth, let go and then brought him penguins for four days, and the full episode reveals what happened when Doug went down to be fed too.

shorts.title: Leopard Seals Ate 7 in 10 Fur Seal Pups on This Beach
shorts.outro: The crabeaters that escape carry its scars for life. Then Doug joined them in a seal costume, with no scars at all. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WILL THE SEAL FALL FOR DOUG'S COSTUME?
shorts.description: At Cape Shirreff leopard seals have eaten about 69 percent of the fur seal pups born each year since 2010, mostly thanks to a few big females, and the full episode asks whether the seal will fall for Doug's seal costume.
